## Summary

Benchmark of common instructions on the 68030, 68040, 68060 and 68080. 100 means one instruction per clock cycle.

## Details

The original shows a line chart "Most used instructions - benchmark test". Its data:

| Instruction | 68030 | 68040 | 68060 | 68080 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ADDQ #im,An` | 50 | 97.2 | 196 | 296 |
| `ADDA.W #im,An` | 15.8 | 96 | 96 | 296 |
| `ADDA.L #im,An` | 13.2 | 95.6 | 64 | 296 |
| `ADDA.L Dn,An` | 48.4 | 48.8 | 196 | 296 |
| `SUBQ #im,An` | 48.4 | 48.8 | 196 | 296 |
| `SUBA.W #im,An` | 16 | 48.8 | 98 | 295 |
| `SUBA.L #im,An` | 13.2 | 76.8 | 64 | 296 |
| `SUBA.L Dn,An` | 48.4 | 48.8 | 196 | 295 |
| `LEA $adr,An` | 13 | 95.2 | 64 | 295 |
| `LEA d16(An),An` | 23.4 | 48.8 | 98 | 295 |
| `LEA d8(An,D0*4),An` | 16 | 24.4 | 96 | 295 |
| `MOVE.L Dn,Dm` | 48.4 | 96.8 | 196 | 296 |
| `CLR.L Dn` | 48.4 | 97.2 | 196 | 296 |
| `MOVEQ #im,Dn` | 48.2 | 96.8 | 196 | 296 |
| `MOVEQ / MOVE.L` | 23.6 | 94.4 | 98 | 296 |
| `MOVE.L #im,Dn` | 13 | 95.2 | 64 | 295 |

| `ADD.W #Im,Dn` | 23.6 | 96.4 | 98 | 295.2 |

| `ADD.L Dn,Dn` | 48.4 | 97.2 | 190 | 295.3 |
| `SUBQ.L #Im,Dn` | 48.4 | 96.8 | 196 | 295.5 |
| `SUB.W #Im,Dn` | 22.8 | 97.2 | 98 | 295.3 |
| `SUB.L #Im,Dn` | 13.2 | 96.8 | 64 | 296 |
| `SUB.L Dn,Dn` | 48.4 | 97.2 | 196 | 295.5 |

| `AND.L Dn,Dn` | 48.4 | 96.4 | 196 | 296 |

| `ORI.L #Im,Dn` | 13.2 | 96.8 | 66 | 296 |
| `OR.L Dn,Dn` | 48.4 | 96.4 | 196 | 295.3 |

| `DIV.L` | 1.2 | 2 | 2.6 | 5.2 |
| `BFFFO Dn,Dm` | 4.8 | 16.4 | 11 | 33 |
| `BFEXTU (a0),Dn` | 0.8 | 1.6 | 1 | 100 |

- 100 means done in 1 clock cycle. (100% Efficient)
- 200 means 2 instructions can be done every clock cycle. (superscalar)
- 50 means 2 cycles are needed to do the instruction.
- (the 68040 actually cheats by using double the clock, so it should be half the value) *(grayed out in the original)*
- Tested 68080 is beta core V4 from jun 2026.

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- Most simple instructions reach about 296 on the 68080 (close to 3 per cycle) against at most about 196 on the 68060.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T assume 68060 relative costs: MULU.L Dn,Da:Db scores 0.4 on the 68060 and 33 on the 68080; BFEXTU (a0),Dn scores 1 on the 68060 and 100 on the 68080.
